title: atomate2 VASP band structure
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk atomate2-band-structure workflow: it runs atomate2's BandStructureMaker, a VASP static calculation, then non-self-consistent calculations on a uniform k-point mesh and along a high-symmetry k-point path. The protocol, the VASP input sets and the custodian error handling are those of atomate2's BandStructureMaker.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure whose band structure is computed.
Output role band_structure_cell is a structures entry containing the structure the band k-points refer to: the cell of the line-mode calculation, output role electronic_band_structure is a records entry containing the band energies of the band-structure cell along the high-symmetry k-point path, in eV, output role electronic_density_of_states is a records entry containing the electronic density of states of the band-structure cell from the uniform k-point mesh, spin-summed, output role band_gap is a records entry containing the band gap of the band-structure cell from the uniform k-point mesh, in eV, output role fermi_energy is a records entry containing the Fermi energy of the uniform k-point-mesh calculation, in eV, and output role task_document is a files entry containing jobflow-outputs.json: the flow's final output (atomate2 task documents) as JSON.

inputs.name: initial_structure
inputs.description: The structure whose band structure is computed.

outputs.name: band_structure_cell
outputs.description: The structure the band k-points refer to: the cell of the line-mode calculation.

outputs.name: electronic_band_structure
outputs.description: The band energies of the band-structure cell along the high-symmetry k-point path, in eV.

outputs.name: electronic_density_of_states
outputs.description: The electronic density of states of the band-structure cell from the uniform k-point mesh, spin-summed.

outputs.name: band_gap
outputs.description: The band gap of the band-structure cell from the uniform k-point mesh, in eV.

outputs.name: fermi_energy
outputs.description: The Fermi energy of the uniform k-point-mesh calculation, in eV.

outputs.name: task_document
outputs.description: jobflow-outputs.json: the flow's final output (atomate2 task documents) as JSON.
